changelog:
Spec prepares complete structured Plan subtrees or individual code Tasks in one explicit invocation, preserving identities and scheduling. Saving work and explicitly approving it remain distinct; readiness requires server inspection.
Build executes the server-selected work one Task at a time with private ownership, a shared branch and pull request, verified completion evidence, and explicit release. Interruption retains the reservation; blockage, review and transfer follow the server's decisions.
These skills require the Plan and manage_build server contracts. They do not merge, publish a release or tag, and local checks or an open pull request do not prove deployment.
